findings.title: linux-x64-musl auth binary built statically (no -crt-static) and published without any check that would notice
findings.label: match
findings.note: Musl leg built with only musl-tools on an Ubuntu host may produce an incorrectly linked binary that fails on Alpine, and no check positively verifies musl linkage on the publish path or preflight.

findings.title: Once armed, any auth build failure holds every JS and EQL npm release
findings.label: valid
findings.note: release job requires publish-auth success when auth=true and EQL artefact jobs need release, so an auth build failure holds other releases; a fail-closed availability risk introduced by this change.

findings.title: Widened release-plz.yml triggers start the armed EQL crate job on unrelated root-workspace pushes
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Workflow-level push paths now include root Cargo files and crate dirs, and the EQL release job has no further path gating, so it runs on unrelated pushes.
